subject: The one dog you need to share this with
preview_text: You know exactly who. Your friend's dog is struggling too. Here's how to help them without being weird.
body_paragraphs: You know that friend whose dog has been putting on weight? The one who jokes about it but you can see the worry in their eyes. I'm talking about the dog who used to sprint after a tennis ball and now gives up after two throws. You've seen it. And you know exactly who I mean.

Here's the thing: most of us don't talk about our dog's weight because we feel guilty. We think it's our fault. But it's not. It's confusing nutrition labels, hidden calories in 'healthy' treats, and the simple fact that every dog is different. You figured it out with PupShape. They haven't.

That's why we built the Share with a Friend feature. One tap sends them a link to download the app and start their own custom plan. No awkward conversation. No judgment. Just a lifeline for their dog's health. And honestly, it makes you look like the hero who cares enough to help.

Open the app now, tap your profile, and hit 'Share with a Friend.' Pick the person you're thinking of. Their dog will thank you. P.S. If you share it with three friends this week, I'll unlock a bonus meal plan for your dog's next milestone. Fair trade.
